requirements.text: The system shall ensure a maximum borrowing limit of 5 books per member to promote safety and accountability.
The system shall notify members of overdue books within 24 hours of the due date to ensure accountability.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status to prevent double borrowing while minimizing energy consumption.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of failure while ensuring energy efficiency.
The system shall allow librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for members with outstanding overdue books to enhance safety.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall log all transactions for audit purposes while ensuring data protection.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall allow up to 5 simultaneous book borrow operations per member to optimize resource utilization.
The system shall track book availability and update the status in real-time to ensure accurate information while minimizing energy consumption.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput and user satisfaction.
The system shall implement role-based access control for librarians and members to enhance security.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding library services.
The system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall enable digital notifications for overdue books to reduce paper waste.
The system shall track the total energy savings achieved through digital operations compared to traditional methods.
